svg.text: When a model is weak or fails
answers when the main one is
start on the cheapest model; when trouble
adds up: reflect, start again from a note,
move up a model; step back down after
a worker on another model that stops or
returns nothing hands its part back: the
main agent does it; after 2 failures that
job runs on the main model
about ten short requests: typed calls, two
at once, required calls, calls written as
text, recovery, window, cache. It says which
jobs the model can take; --write saves it
Model card and profile (.amness/profile.json): window, tier (local, mid, frontier), toolChoice, thinkingBudget, keepThinking, request,
tools, prompt, textToolCalls. A job on another model is called with that model's own settings.
A job's model is an id on the main provider, provider:model, or server:<name>[/model]. Each model keeps its own window and profile.
